content:
The **Flare Gun** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

The flare gun is a break-action single-shot weapon that is designed for signaling (by firing skyward) as opposed to combat. Firing a flare directly at an enemy will cause a negligible amount of damage. The flare gun cannot be modified at a Weapons Workbench.
